h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ongole

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ongole

items.pText: In Ongole and across Prakasam district, children rarely come to a playground alone. A parent, grandparent or older sibling usually waits nearby, often for an hour or more in the evening when the heat eases. Yet many play areas we see have nowhere for those adults to sit except a kerb or a wall, and no shade over it.

FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment and garden furniture at our factory in Vasai, about 870 km away, and sends both to Ongole by road. Our installation team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs them together. When you plan a school, park or society playground here, we suggest thinking about the adults as well. Share the site size, the age group and photos, and our layout drawing will show seating along with the safe play area.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Seating and shade for the adults who wait

c: Benches belong at the edge of the play area, outside every safe play area but close enough for adults to see each piece. Our
includes benches, gazebos and pergolas made for outdoor use.

In coastal Andhra's summer, a gazebo or pergola makes the difference between a park that empties at four in the afternoon and one that stays busy. Bins near the seating keep the area clean. If the adults want to exercise while they wait, a few pieces from our
can sit along the same path.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 870 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply benches and gazebos as well as playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Our garden decor range includes benches, gazebos, pergolas and bins. We can place them on the same layout drawing as the play equipment.

items.q: Where should benches go in a play area?
items.a: Just outside the safe play areas, with a clear view of the equipment. Seats placed too close can become something children climb on or run into.

items.q: Do you deliver to Ongole and Prakasam district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Ongole and nearby towns such as Kavali and Narasaraopet, and our team or a dealer installs everything.
